question: How do I add, update or delete entities?

items: Open the entities list. For example, to open a list of items click on the toolbar "Dictionaries'" button with "copy" icon and select "Items".
Click the Add button with the "+" icon
See the added entity in the entities list
Click on the entity. It should be highlighted.
Click the Update button with the "pencil" icon
See the updated entity in the entities list
Click on the entity. It should be highlighted.
Click the Delete button with the "trash" icon
Make sure the entity is no longer in the list of entities.
